versions.changelog: Fix auth/claim method, purchase no-auth, add purchase flow warning, cron polling, all game tags

Initial release of the supercraft-game-servers skill:

- Manage dedicated servers for 17+ popular games via Supercraft REST API.
- Order, configure, start, stop, and restart game servers with simple HTTP requests.
- Token-based authentication using a magic link login flow.
- Browse game catalog, available regions, and pricing without authentication.
- Includes endpoint reference and usage examples for all server management and purchasing operations.
